carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.h: Harrell leaves East Carolina for Stanford and a No. 25 ranking
carousel:H0ldStillPlease:move:832438379:.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] goes from a 19-19 run at [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] to a Stanford program that starts the year ranked No. 25. Players on both rosters are already deciding whether to stay.

quote.text: He sold the Stanford staff on a clean slate. Whether the roster buys it is another question.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

831914385:upset.h: No. 1 Ohio State falls at Nebraska, and the playoff picture cracks on opening week
831914385:upset.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] arrived as the nation's top team and left [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] with a loss it can't hide from. The Huskers outgained the Buckeyes 491 to 448. Tuddy_roosevelt now has to explain how his defense got outworked.

quote.text: We thought we were ready. We weren't ready for how physical they'd be.
quote.by: an Ohio State player, per a source close to the program

831914385:4th:832438348.h: Nebraska went for it on fourth down, and Ohio State never recovered
831914385:4th:832438348.d: The Huskers kept the punter on the bench in a 28-25 win over [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] and converted 3 of 4 tries. Each conversion drained more life from the Buckeyes' defense. Sideline chatter says that group was gassed by the end.

quote.text: Every time they stayed out there you could see our guys looking at each other.
quote.by: an Ohio State defender, per a source close to the program

561119626battle.h: Ole Miss Holds Narrow Edge on Wilds, but Texas Isn't Backing Off
561119626battle.d: The five-star corner wants a title contender, and both schools are pitching that hard. Ole Miss has the lead, Texas is right behind, and Oklahoma is still in the picture.

quote.text: He keeps asking one question: who's playing in December? Everything else is noise.
quote.by: a person close to the recruitment

561121675battle.h: Missouri Leads for Favre, but Indiana Is Making Its Move
561121675battle.d: Conference prestige is the sticking point for Favre. Missouri has the lead, Indiana is pushing, and Michigan is lurking in case either slips.

quote.text: He's got a spreadsheet of league schedules. I'm not joking. Prestige matters to him.
quote.by: a coach familiar with the recruitment

561125724battle.h: Home Pull Could Tip Coburn to Alabama as Clemson Digs In
561125724battle.d: Clemson has held its ground with the five-star linebacker, but Coburn wants to stay close to Coral Springs. Alabama is the shorter trip home, and Ole Miss is hanging around as a fallback.

quote.text: His mom wants Sundays at the dinner table. That's not a small thing in this one.
quote.by: a source close to the family

561121494battle.h: Georgia Has the Edge for Yeast, but Miami Won't Fold
561121494battle.d: Playing time is Yeast's dealbreaker, and Georgia's depth chart pitch is working. Miami is selling an immediate role, and Tennessee is a distant third.

quote.text: Miami keeps showing him the reps he'd get on day one. Georgia has to answer that.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

561120536battle.h: Notre Dame's Spotlight Could Flip Longo From Missouri
561120536battle.d: Missouri holds a slim lead for the five-star receiver. But Longo wants the national stage, and Notre Dame's brand pitch is landing. Oklahoma is still a threat, and official visits could decide this one.

quote.text: He wants to be seen. Notre Dame knows that and is leaning on it.
quote.by: a person close to the recruitment

561121938battle.h: Texas Holds Edge for Simonson, but Tennessee and USC Aren't Going Away
561121938battle.d: [[r:561121938|K. Simonson]] has Texas in front, Tennessee close behind and USC still in the picture. Conference prestige is his dealbreaker, and the Longhorns are benefiting from it. One more big week could settle it.

quote.text: He keeps coming back to the league he'll be playing in. That's the first thing he brings up every time we talk.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

557717923:breakout.h: Sophomore Naanee's breakout leaves East Carolina with a pricey problem
557717923:breakout.d: [[p:557717923|L.Naanee]] is up 13 points to 78 overall and earning nothing in NIL. With a coaching change at [[t:832438301|East Carolina]], rival collectives are already taking notice.

quote.text: A new staff, a big jump, and no money. Calls are going to start coming.
quote.by: a rival collective source

557711974:breakout.h: Ball State freshman Gastineau is a bigger name than anyone budgeted for
557711974:breakout.d: [[p:557711974|J.Gastineau]], a freshman corner, jumped 13 points to 76 overall and earns nothing in NIL. [[t:832438282|Ball State]] ranks 96th in NIL spending, so a bidding war is a losing proposition.

quote.text: Bigger programs have noticed him. Ball State can't match that kind of money.
quote.by: a portal-watching source

557714494:breakout.h: Baylor receiver Fuller is getting paid like a role player and playing like a star
557714494:breakout.d: [[p:557714494|M.Fuller]] is up 12 points to 82 overall and earning nothing in NIL. Expect collectives to circle the sophomore, and [[t:832438283|Baylor]] has little time to fix it.

quote.text: He's earning nothing, and everyone knows it. That changes fast.
quote.by: a source familiar with Baylor's roster

557720960:breakout.h: Kennesaw State freshman Levine is a star on a small-budget team
557720960:breakout.d: [[p:557720960|P.Levine]] is up 12 points to 82 overall, and his NIL number is still zero. [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] ranks 113th in NIL spending, so keeping him will be hard.

quote.text: Players like that don't stay on small-school money for long.
quote.by: a rival recruiting coordinator

557724098:breakout.h: Florida State's Shor is up 11 points, and he knows his worth
557724098:breakout.d: [[p:557724098|J.Shor]], a freshman receiver, jumped 11 points to 80 overall and earns nothing in NIL. Keeping him will cost [[t:832438310|Florida State]], which has plenty of other holes.

quote.text: He's not going to ask. Other schools will do it for him.
quote.by: a person close to the program

557719266:underpaid.h: Tennessee has one of the cheapest 89-rated guards in the sport
557719266:underpaid.d: [[p:557719266|L.Trueblood]] is making nothing in NIL while players at his position and rating command around 190K. [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]'s deep NIL pockets help, but staffs elsewhere have noticed.

quote.text: You don't find 89 guards at that price. Someone will pay him.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557712567:fit.h: Carraway may not want to stay in a Stanford pass defense that struggles
557712567:fit.d: [[p:557712567|D.Carraway]] is an 84-overall hybrid safety on a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] defense ranked 135th of 138 against the pass. New coach Harrell has a talent to keep on his hands.

quote.text: He's a good player stuck in a bad system. That's a recipe for the portal.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

557716795:fit.h: Penn State's Stockton is a running back to watch if the ground game doesn't improve
557716795:fit.d: [[p:557716795|I.Stockton]] is an 81-overall contact seeker in a Penn State system that ranks 122nd of 138 in rushing. agerm40 needs to fix the run game or risk losing him.

quote.text: He wants a system that actually runs the ball. Right now it's not that.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

557714489:underpaid.h: B.Bouye Is an 87-Overall Back With No NIL Deal. Is SMU the Answer?
557714489:underpaid.d: [[p:557714489|B.Bouye]] has no NIL money, while running backs at his level get around 85K. Collectives are lining up, and [[t:832438375|SMU]] is a name coming up in the chatter. Running backs with this production don't stay unpaid for long once the portal opens.

quote.text: A back like that doesn't sit on the market. The first serious offer is probably the one he takes.
quote.by: a portal-focused agent

557726531:fit.h: Florida State's pass defense could push top safety Page out the door
557726531:fit.d: [[p:557726531|T.Page]] is an 88-overall coverage safety on a [[t:832438310|Florida State]] defense ranked 136th of 138 against the pass. Good players don't stay in bad systems.

quote.text: He knows he's too good for this. The question is who calls first.
quote.by: a source close to the Florida State program

557719942:underpaid.h: Melvin is playing like a star at tackle and getting paid like a backup
557719942:underpaid.d: [[p:557719942|J.Melvin]] is an 84-overall tackle making 30K, while players at his position and rating command around 85K. That gap tends to close in the portal.

quote.text: Linemen like that don't stay underpaid. Someone will fix it.
quote.by: a rival staffer

557712320:underpaid.h: Georgia could be the school to cash in on cornerback Maddox
557712320:underpaid.d: [[p:557712320|K.Maddox]] is an 84-overall corner making nothing in NIL, while players like him command around 50K. [[t:832438312|Georgia]]'s deep pockets make it a natural suitor, but it won't be alone.

quote.text: Georgia has the money and the need. He's on their board.
quote.by: a source familiar with the process

557719687:underpaid.h: Texas Receiver T.Bada Is Producing Like a Star and Earning Nothing
557719687:underpaid.d: [[p:557719687|T.Bada]] is an 87-overall receiver with no NIL deal, while comparable receivers get around 90K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has one of the deepest collectives in the country, but rivals are already calling.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he's worth. The only question is whether Texas fixes it before somebody else does.
quote.by: a rival collective staffer

557727130:underpaid.h: E.Udoh Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
557727130:underpaid.d: [[p:557727130|E.Udoh]] is an 88-overall receiver with no NIL money, while receivers at his level get around 105K. Collectives know the gap well, and one source says he has already heard from several of them.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he knows the market. His phone isn't quiet.
quote.by: a person familiar with his situation

561121140battle.h: Texas Clings to Lead for Wolf as Texas Tech Crashes the Party
561121140battle.d: The five-star corner cares most about snaps. Texas leads, but Texas Tech has reportedly sold him on a bigger role, and Ole Miss is lurking behind both.

quote.text: Wolf keeps hearing the same promise from three schools. He wants to see it in writing.
quote.by: a source close to the program

561119899commit.h: Stanford Lands Durante, a California Safety Who Wanted to Start
561119899commit.d: Stanford sold the three-star strong safety on a chance to compete right away. For a pass defense that has been a problem, that pitch carries weight. Durante is staying close to home, and his family played a role.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.
quote.by: M. Durante
